questions.text: Which production process does Plant 1100 (Processing) use?
questions.explanation: Plant 1100 (Processing) uses Repetitive Manufacturing with MF42N for product delivery and Standard (STD) BOM consumption — different from the Production Order approach used in farm operations.

questions.text: Which variance settlement approach does Repetitive Manufacturing (REM) use?
options: Order Level — per individual production order
Month-End — accumulated and settled collectively at period close
questions.explanation: REM plants use Month-End variance settlement, where variances accumulate throughout the period and are settled collectively — unlike Production Order plants that settle at Order Level.

questions.text: Which plants have Batch Management active? (Select the best answer)
options: GP Laying (3200), GP Hatchery (3100), Parent Laying (1220), Hatchery (1210), Further Processing (1050), C.Layer Finished Product (1250)
questions.explanation: Batch Management is active at: GP Laying (3200), GP Hatchery (3100), Parent Laying (1220), Hatchery (1210), Further Processing (1050), and C.Layer Finished Product (1250) — the plants requiring food safety traceability.

options: Components are issued based on standard BOM quantities
Components are issued based on actual quantities consumed (backflushing or manual GI)
Components are consumed at the end of the month only
BOM consumption is estimated from historical averages
questions.explanation: Consume BOM – Actual means components are issued based on actual quantities consumed, using backflushing or manual goods issue. This is used in farm-type production orders (opposite of Standard, used in REM).

questions.text: Which order type is used by Further Processing (Plant 1050)?
questions.explanation: Further Processing (Plant 1050) uses order type YPP2. YPP1 is for pullets and DOC; YPP3 for graded eggs; YPP4 for hatching egg orders; YPP5 for floor/cage houses.

questions.text: What does MF42N stand for and what does it do?
options: REM Backflush — confirms production and issues components simultaneously
Master File 42N — manages production master data
Monthly Freeze 42N — locks period for settlement
questions.explanation: MF42N is the Repetitive Manufacturing Backflush transaction. It simultaneously confirms finished product output and issues (backflushes) all consumed components.

questions.text: How many plants in AWP use Repetitive Manufacturing (REM)?
questions.explanation: Five plants use REM: 1100 Processing, 1010 Finished-Water, 1020 Protein Factory, 1130 Manure Factory, and 1140 Yanbu Grain. C.Layer Finished Product (1250) also uses REM — making it 5–6 depending on counting.

questions.text: Which plant uses Co11N (not Migo or MF42N) as its primary Product Delivery method?
questions.explanation: Plant 1120 Feed-Mill uses Co11N as its Product Delivery method (with Production Order type and YPP2 order type). GP Hatchery uses Migo & Co11n combined.
